summary: Recover interrupted campaigns within a persistent budget
description: Extend campaign supervision with durable dispatch/checkpoints, process ownership, finite repair attempts, context refresh and cumulative budgets across process restarts. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: Injected controller death before/after dispatch, during checks and between tasks recovers the exact pending stage; a live orphan or unknown process identity cannot authorize a second writer. Preserve task files and raw failed attempts.

Campaign walltime/command budgets and repair limits persist across resume. No silent budget replenishment or model fallback; temporary provider failures use bounded backoff and unchanged model binding.

Detect repeated no-progress attempts from inspected evidence rather than merely retrying the same prompt. Within mandate, change repair strategy or isolate research; otherwise record a precise blocker and proceed only with eligible independent tasks.

Pause/drain/cancel have explicit effects; stop only owned processes, preserve work and reconcile started external effects. New workers get canonical current task/architecture and relevant failed proof, not an assumed surviving transcript.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
